orientation.title: Orientation and profile assessment
items: Review of your academic and school background.
Verification of diplomas, grades and eligibility.
Identification of accessible programs and levels.
Language proficiency assessment.
Advice on your chances and application hurdles, with no guarantee of selection.
Development of a personalized application strategy.

bourses.title: Scholarship research and selection
items: Search for government, provincial and university scholarships.
Identification of universities matching your profile.
Search for programs taught in Chinese or English.
Verification of admission requirements and deadlines.
Comparison of full and partial scholarships.

dossier.title: Application file preparation and optimization
items: Creation or improvement of your academic CV.
Preparation of your study or research proposal.
Verification of diplomas, transcripts and translations.
Organization and review of administrative documents.
Preparation for required language or admission tests.

candidatures.title: Application management and tracking
items: Document review before submission.
Tracking of deadlines and additional requests.
Tracking of admission and scholarship results.
Support in case of rejection: analysis of identifiable causes.

trust.title: What we guarantee you, with full transparency
trust.admission: we only submit complete, verified application files. No one can honestly promise you guaranteed admission, and we won't either.
trust.scholarship: we prepare your application to maximize your chances, but the award depends on criteria we do not control: academic results, interview, number of available places, university choice.
trust.visa: we help you build a complete, solid file; the final decision belongs to the consular authorities.

languagePrograms.title: Learning Chinese in China: what to expect.
languagePrograms.intro: A semester or a year of Chinese classes at a Chinese university, with preparation for the HSK, the official Chinese exam.
languagePrograms.reducedText: Tuition and accommodation at reduced rates, paid directly to the university.
languagePrograms.freeText: Depending on the university: free tuition, a monthly stipend or a bonus based on your results.
offers: Stipend up to 10,000 RMB / year depending on your results
Top-tier university · open up to age 40
languagePrograms.note: Amounts in RMB, set by the universities. The FCFA estimate is provided once the procedure is approved. Full list: language offers catalog.
languagePrograms.licenceText: Choose a Bachelor's with language included directly (March intake): 6 months of Chinese at the same university, then your degree in September, at the Bachelor's fee. If you choose language only, any later support towards a degree will be charged at the current rate, with no discount.

calendar.title: Two intakes a year: March and September.
calendar.intro: For both intakes, applications are being prepared now.
calendar.march: Applications are open now. Places are limited: the earlier the file is submitted, the better.
calendar.september: That's now too. Some universities take several months to review applications and organize interviews.

timeline.languageNote: Depending on the university or the type of scholarship, this language session is free or paid. We tell you for each university we propose.

example.title: How a Bachelor's scholarship works.
example.intro: For Bachelor's degrees, scholarships are mostly partial: a full scholarship requires a high-school average of around 16 or 17/20. But a partial scholarship is still a real advantage.
example.university: Jiangsu University of Science and Technology: 1,400,000 FCFA per year, accommodation included. With a 50% scholarship, you pay 700,000 FCFA.
example.bonusTitle: 2. At the end of the year: a cash bonus based on your results
example.wave: {n, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} tier
example.callout: In this example, the 1st tier receives 800,000 FCFA — more than the 700,000 FCFA paid.
example.more: And that's just the start: good results can be rewarded every year with additional scholarships.
example.disclaimer: Indicative example: each university has its own scholarship system.

journey.title: How a {name} scholarship works.
journey.role: Our role: build a solid research project with you and contact the research supervisors whose fields match your profile.

arrival.title: Welcomed at the airport, settled in a ready room.
arrival.intro: On the big day, you are not alone: we take you safely to your destination and your room is ready from the first night.
arrival.pickupText: A member of the Odysseo team or a representative waits for you at the airport exit, helps with your luggage and drives you to your university. No taxi to negotiate, no language barrier: you go straight to campus.
arrival.roomText: We take care of the basic equipment of your room: mattress, sheets, pillow, blanket and small everyday essentials. Nothing to rush out and buy when you arrive tired from the journey.

ticket.title: You buy it freely, at the right time.
ticket.intro: You choose the airline, the date and the best price, or a relative can offer it to you. We tell you when to buy it.
ticket.when: When to buy it: only after the visa is granted, ideally 3 to 6 weeks before departure.
ticket.arrive: When to arrive: during the registration period of your Admission Notice, usually late February / early March or late August / early September. We confirm the date for your university.
ticket.send: Send us your ticket as soon as you buy it: we schedule your pick-up for your landing time.

pricing.optionTitle: Option: help to obtain an English test
